done_when: forge.toml sets workers = "codex" with Codex models for build, fix and lite, matching the owner's setup elsewhere, and forge doctor passes

findings.body: The required suite-wired test through Forge's real command entry point is missing. package.json:86–88 runs unit and integration suites, neither of which exercises this configuration through Forge. .github/workflows/forge.yml:47 invokes only `forge hook pr-check`. Consequently, reverting the worker selection to Claude would not fail the required regression test. Add coverage that verifies Codex worker/model selection for build, fix and lite and checks `forge doctor` success. The recorded manual doctor pass does not satisfy the explicit automated-test requirement.
findings.title: Not done: end-to-end coverage for Codex worker selection and forge doctor

why: This repo still builds with Claude workers, but the owner wants Codex workers for all implementation in every repo
